803-2187-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-2187-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

225-997-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
225-997-2577-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-6495.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

101-7694-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
101-7694-8043.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-864-2279-2921-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2279-2921-3125.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

586-864-3125-3967-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-3967-5477.description:
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

348-789-1152-2992-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-789-1152-2992-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Gutter Grime triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

475-1379-3197-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1379-3197-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4871-7773.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Teacher's Pest, adding {B}.
When Teacher's Pest dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Teacher's Pest by paying {B}{G}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4251-5434-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Godo has vigilance.
4251-5434-6911.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Godo, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Godo that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Godo and the Godo token as attackers, choosing to exert the Godo token as it attacks.
The Godo token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-4689-5434.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4689-5434.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, causing you to get an experience counter and creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

49-2034-4871-6201-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sunscape Familiar.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2034-2068-2762-5346.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability twice by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C},
Crime Novelist triggers, causing you to add {R} and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the other Thopter token.
Ashnod and Crime Novelist trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ashnod trigger, copying Thopter Squadron's ability.
Resolve both Thopter Squadron abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it,.
Repeat.

338-3490-3641-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-3641-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

856-2438-3263-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4316-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1636-5231-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
1636-5231-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
Repeat.

104-997-2086.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2079-3204-4364-6188.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2079-3204-4364-6188.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1283-4067.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two colors among permanents you control.
1283-4067.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability by paying {5} and tapping it, causing you to draw a card for each color among permanents you control.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.

2178-3143-4680.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
2178-3143-4680.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature you control.
When the creature dies, Xavier Sal triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability from step 1, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel legendary artifact creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

261-1722-2034-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
261-1722-2034-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2564-3227-3603-4231.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Scrivener.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

539-579-3932.notablePrerequisites: Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
539-579-3932.description:
Activate a mana-producing land  by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Hope Tender's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and exerting it, untapping Hope Tender and the mana-producing land.
Repeat.

2904-4046.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Outrider en-Kor ability.
Repeat.

292-1495-3129.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-3129.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

2857-3464-4050.description:
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout with its enter the battlefield trigger targeting Adarkar Valkyrie.
Maintaing priority, anctivate Adarkar Valkyrie's ability targeting Hyrax Tower Scout.
Adarkar Valkyrie's ability resolves and Hyrax Tower Scout's trigger resolves untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Sacrifice Hyrax Tower Scout to Phyrexian Altar.
Adarkar Valkyrie's ability triggers and returns Hyrax Tower Scout to the battlefield.
Repeat.
